output.explanation: Implemented all nine b05 edits from pinned revision 6c15ecece45db34f3f045c0eee8ef524b0b7b6ea. The diagrams show structured prompt capture, reusable generation context, explicit subtree membership, two-stage proposal generation, and distinct change/source coverage measurements sharing one renderer. Proposal acceptance remains separate. These interfaces establish dependencies for later chat, push callers, variants and direct batches without portraying those features as implemented. All diagrams fit their reserved bounds; new diagrams contain exactly 40, 40, 36 and 32 concept lines. Existing attachment labels remain exact, and only the five specified edges are returned.
